text: It's a really good app. As it fits my needs more than all the others I have tested, I decided to pay it. It has some glitches, but it does what I mainly want.
author: George Kourgiantakis
developer_reply:
Hi George!
Thank you so much for your feedback. We are grateful to hear that Habitify can be your partner in the Journey of building good habits, and we do hope that we together can go further and further in this journey.
While using the app, if you have any questions or suggestions for the development of Habitify, please feel free to share!

text: Χρειάζεται συνδρομή για να βάλεις πάνω από 5 συνήθειες
author: Μαρία Παππά
developer_reply: Thanks for your feedback. The limitation on free use is to prevent the overwhelming for beginners. Premium can remove all and add new features. We can support you with a 14-day trial if you want to try it first so that you can be confident with your purchase. Just let us know if you need our support via the in-app chatbox at any time!
